_comment: Tolerant expectations used by tests/test_model.py. Measured with scripts/calibrate_guard.py on 2026-10-27 (CLIP ViT-B/32 + LogisticRegression, scikit-learn 1.6.1). The model is small and trained on Wikimedia photos; these samples are AI-generated illustrations, so it is out of its training distribution. Values are observations, not guarantees.

sample-madhubani.jpg.note: Madhubani is the weakest class (F1 0.49). The model ranks Pattachitra first on this illustration.

sample-gond.jpg.known_miss: Gond is ranked third. Do not assert a correct class here; this documents a domain-shift failure of the model on AI-generated illustrations.

wrong_style.expect: style_match_score is lower than when the same image is submitted as warli, and predicted_art_form stays warli
